Terms of Service

By using HazardPulse, you agree to the following terms.

Important

HazardPulse is a research platform, not an official warning system. Do not use it as your sole source for emergency decisions.

Always follow official guidance from these agencies:

  • weather.gov — National Weather Service
  • earthquake.usgs.gov — USGS Earthquake Hazards
  • nhc.noaa.gov — National Hurricane Center
  • spc.noaa.gov — Storm Prediction Center

Nature of service

HazardPulse is an independent natural hazard research platform operated by Coherence Energy Labs. It provides probabilistic hazard intelligence for earthquakes, hurricanes, and tornadoes based on publicly available government data.

HazardPulse is not an operational warning system. It does not issue official forecasts, watches, warnings, or advisories. Outputs are model-based probability estimates intended for research and informational purposes.

No warranty

All data, forecasts, and probabilistic outputs are provided "as is" and "as available" without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including but not limited to warranties of accuracy, completeness, merchantability, or fitness for a particular purpose.

HazardPulse makes no guarantee that any individual prediction will be correct. Probabilistic forecasts express estimated likelihoods, not certainties.

Official guidance requirement

Users must consult official government sources for authoritative hazard information and emergency decision-making:

  • USGS for earthquake monitoring and alerts
  • NHC for tropical cyclone forecasts and warnings
  • NWS for weather forecasts and warnings
  • SPC for severe weather outlooks and watches

HazardPulse outputs should never be used as the sole basis for evacuation, sheltering, or any emergency management decision.
